scheme_name: Samekit Baal Vikas Chhtra Yojana: Dress for Pre-school Children
other_conditions: The beneficiary must be a child
The beneficiary must be enrolled at an Anganwadi Centre and receiving pre‑school education
The beneficiary must be a resident of Bihar
benefits_summary: ₹400 per child per year is provided for uniforms to children aged 3‑6 attending Anganwadi pre‑school education.
